habitat: Pairs in riverine forest, the fringes of lowland and coastal forest, thornveld around pans and vleis, and around farmsteads and suburbia. It is not a social weaver.
summary: A common resident. All-yellow, with darker wings, an orange wash on the head, a black bill and a black eye-stripe to the ear coverts. The eyes are pale. The male has a black bib. The immature has a horn-coloured bill. The call is a descending tee-tee-tee-tee-tee-tee-tee. It is not a social weaver. The Kemp paper name Spectacled Weaver and the code RB were left unchanged.

similar.note: Southern Masked Weaver has a full black mask and red eyes. Spectacled Weaver has a black eye-stripe to the ear coverts, pale eyes, and a black bib only on the male.
